name: workspace.init
title: Initialise workspace
summary: Create a workspace with the standard model in a folder, which is created when only it is missing. Adds `*.reqseq-tmp` (temp files of an interrupted write) to the folder's `.gitignore`.
whileReadOnlyReason: Creates the workspace, so there is no metamodel yet that could make it read-only.

path.description: Folder of the workspace, created when only it is missing; must not contain reqseq-workspace.yaml or the metamodel file.

name.description: Name of the workspace, written to reqseq-workspace.yaml.

metamodel.description: Where the metamodel lies. Default: the folder `metamodel` in the main repository, where the standard model is written.

repository.description: Workspace name of the repository of the metamodel. Default: the main repository.

path.description: Folder of the metamodel, relative to that repository. Default: `metamodel`.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.
